interpretation: Human-reviewed evidence map. The runner checks source identity, not the truth of every sentence or raw-market provenance. Forecast arithmetic is independently reconciled in separate tables. All rows refer to already consumed history; NONE is new independent evidence.

studies.dates: 2021-2025 primary/transport; earlier history supplies engine context
studies.population: CSI1000 R1_A 1296 per horizon; STAR50 R1_A 1804 at h1-h60,1803 h120,1802 h240
studies.unit: mean bp; fraction; close-path excursion bp
studies.target: signed event return at fixed observed-bar horizon
studies.reported_result: CSI1000 R1_A h15/h30 mean +4.80/+6.80bp; descriptive horizon-local flags
studies.limitation: No parent-control subtraction, costs, independent replication or familywise inference. A raw-event count is not the later 240-complete matched count.
studies.reason: Different dates, denominators and target. Favorable raw return is not prediction-MSE gain.

studies.population: CSI1000 R1_A 1296; STAR50 R1_A 1802 terminal-240-complete original pairs
studies.unit: event minus selected-control return bp; pointwise bootstrap interval bp
studies.target: finite nearest-parent matched contrast with replacement
studies.reported_result: CSI1000 h15/h30 increment +3.85/+6.07bp; early strong-incremental interpretation
studies.limitation: Retrospective controls, overlap/reuse, conditional comparability; early supported wording is not current confirmatory authority after later robustness checks.
studies.reason: Selected-control return contrast differs from two predictions of the same event; later uncertainty checks change confidence, not the old observed mean.

studies.population: Fixed original R1_A pairs; all event/control prices through 240 bars must satisfy full-path observation rules
studies.unit: coverage fraction; admitted carrier return bp
studies.reported_result: Original v1 remains PARTIAL_CARRIER_TRANSPORT; primary CSI1000 coverage failure is not alpha failure
studies.limitation: A separate strict path-availability contract. Do not overwrite it with the later endpoint result or use it as the latest whole-program status.
studies.reason: Data-observation status is not a forecast or alpha test.

studies.population: CSI1000 h15=1268,h30=1259 of1296; STAR50 per-horizon 1801-1802 of1802; common cohort differs
studies.unit: ETF/index event and paired increment bp
studies.target: four positive-volume exact-time endpoints per horizon, same-sample index comparison
studies.reported_result: CSI1000 ETF h15/h30 increment +4.368/+7.074bp; same-sample index +3.894/+6.527bp
studies.limitation: Different eligible samples by horizon, future exit observability, missing-not-random possibility, no execution PnL. Primary all-seven common cohort remains unscored.
studies.reason: For h30 full-index +6.074 to subset-index +6.527 is selection; subset-index to ETF +7.074 is observed carrier difference. Neither is forecast loss.

studies.population: two ETFs x seven horizons; disclosed reuse/overlap/selection
studies.unit: increment bp; approximate uncertainty bp; sensitivity bounds
studies.target: uncertainty around previously observed endpoint increments
studies.reported_result: No primary adjusted interval entirely above zero; positive short-horizon point estimates remain
studies.limitation: Dependence/calibration assumptions and earlier research selection not eliminated. Failure to reject zero is not evidence of exactly zero effect.
studies.reason: Confidence about the old increment changed; no new independent sample and no new forecast model.

studies.dates: old design estimates and simulations; 2026 metadata only
studies.population: fixed 2/4/6bp planning scenarios and simulated dependence designs
studies.unit: conditional sample requirements, power fractions, false-positive fractions
studies.target: information costs and calibration behavior under assumed models
studies.reported_result: Small-effect confirmation costly under inherited assumptions; some persistent-correlation scenarios overreject
studies.limitation: Not a forecast of decades of stable market data, not achieved power and not proof that R1_A has no advantage.
studies.reason: Planning/simulation outputs cannot be pooled with observed market gains.

studies.dates: synthetic scenarios calibrated around already consumed designs
studies.population: three implementable methods plus covariance-aware oracle; fixed scenarios
studies.target: error control under declared simulated dependence
studies.reported_result: No implementable method met the complete declared screen; signed-leg cancellation affects simulation difficulty
studies.limitation: Simulated persistent shocks are not identified actual-market noise. Oracle is not deployable. Method sweep closed.
studies.reason: No real R1_A mean was retested by these new methods.

studies.population: 1752 CSI1000 pairs;156 STAR50 context pairs;common 240-complete cohort
studies.unit: individual SD bp; variance/covariance bp^2; calendar/clock geometry
studies.target: event/control covariance and actual calendar contribution accounting
studies.reported_result: Event dispersion dominates pair scale; concentrated reused/overlapping controls dominate some calendar contributions
studies.limitation: Pair SD is not mean SE; calendar variance is not long-run estimator variance; geometric energy not attained variance reduction.
studies.reason: Includes 645 CSI1000 2015 warmup events omitted from forecast scoring; has a different target.

studies.population: 1752/156 original events; final241/17 assigned pairs; returns not opened
studies.reported_result: Coverage/retention failed; own same-year capacity upper bound70.21% below80% target
studies.limitation: Overconstrained design failure, not R1_A failure. Narrow selected-pair outcome remains unopened; no retrospective relaxation.
studies.reason: No new alpha outcome exists to contradict another study.

studies.population: 1752 original events;645 explicit warmup;1107 scored at each horizon
studies.unit: MSE gain bp^2; RMSE bp; relative MSE fraction
studies.target: squared-error difference on same actual event between fixed parent ridge and parent+R1_A ridge
studies.reported_result: h15/h30 pooled MSE reductions0.2837%/0.2872% but weak year/side consistency;h60 still worse than zero forecast
studies.limitation: Weak finite baseline, global additive indicator, annual refitting, historical reuse. Not causal treatment effect, model-free information test or trading alpha.
studies.reason: Only this row supplies the already stored forecast errors being decomposed; current audit is not another independent forecast sample.
